reprozip_dir.description: Directory where reprozip stores the trace database and configuration file.

ident_packages.description: If true, attempts to identify which installed package each file in the trace comes from.

identify_io.description: If true, attempts to identify which files are inputs and which are outputs of the experiment.

usage_report.description: Enables or disables anonymous usage reports sent to the reprozip developers.

program_args.description: List of arguments to pass to the program being traced. Items are strings.
